title: Hunger
subtitle: 「飢餓／缺乏食物／糧食不安全」，究竟是哪一種 hunger？
description: 「飢餓／缺乏食物／糧食不安全」，究竟是哪一種 hunger？

words.meaning: 糧食不安全；食物取得不穩定
words.note: 指個人或家庭無法穩定取得足夠、安全、有營養的食物，重點是「取得食物的可靠性」，不一定表示當下正在挨餓。
words.example: Rising food prices have increased food insecurity among low-income households.
words.exampleZh: 食品價格上升令低收入家庭的糧食不安全問題惡化。

exercises.original: Many low-income households experience hunger because they are not sure they can afford enough food every week.
exercises.zh: 很多低收入家庭面臨糧食不安全，因為他們不能確定每星期都有能力購買足夠食物。
exercises.upgrade: food insecurity · 糧食不安全；食物取得不穩定

options.explanation: not sure they can afford enough food every week 直接描述食物取得的不穩定性，而不是單一一餐後的飢餓感。
表示極端、長時間食物不足；原句只確定取得食物不穩定，不能直接推論已到 starvation。
是個人身體短期餓感，不是家庭經濟／食物取得問題。
是沒有食慾，與買不起足夠食物不同。
是地區／人口層級嚴重糧荒，規模過大。
可能是後果，但原句並未提供營養狀態診斷。

exercises.original: The survey asks whether families ever worry that their food will run out before they can afford to buy more.
exercises.zh: 調查詢問家庭是否曾擔心食物用完後無力購買更多，藉此衡量糧食不安全。

options.explanation: 擔心食物用完與無力補充，是典型 food-access reliability 問題。
不一定有地區性大規模危機。
不能由「擔心」直接推論到極端挨餓。
是身體感受，不是 household survey 的供應／負擔能力概念。

exercises.original: Rising rents have left some families with too little money to buy enough nutritious food consistently.
exercises.zh: 租金上升令部分家庭沒有足夠金錢持續購買足量有營養食物。
exercises.upgrade: food insecurity · 食物取得不穩定

options.explanation: too little money + consistently + nutritious food 明確指 affordability 與可靠取得食物。
原句沒有說已出現生命危險的極端熱量不足。
可能因長期飲食不足出現，但原句重點是 access，不是已診斷營養狀態。

words.meaning: 對食物的需要；需要進食
words.note: 最直接的解釋性改寫，適合描述生理上的食物需求，但不是固定技術術語。
words.example: Hunger is the body's signal of a need for food.
words.exampleZh: 飢餓是身體發出需要食物的訊號。

exercises.original: Hunger is the body's signal that it needs food after several hours without eating.
exercises.zh: 幾小時沒進食後，飢餓是身體發出的食物需求訊號。
exercises.upgrade: need for food · 對食物的需要；需要進食

options.explanation: 句子是在解釋生理飢餓訊號的基本功能；plain-English need for food 最直接。
是取得食物不穩定的社會／家庭概念，不是身體訊號。
營養狀態，不是即時身體訊號。
程度遠強於數小時未進食。
表示不想吃，與 hunger 相反方向。

exercises.original: After a long hike without lunch, his hunger was simply a normal physical signal.
exercises.zh: 長途遠足又沒吃午餐後，他的飢餓只是正常的生理食物需求。
exercises.upgrade: need for food · 食物需求

options.explanation: long hike without lunch 解釋的是短期能量需要，而不是結構性糧食問題。
規模與嚴重度完全不合。
短暫沒吃午餐不等於 starvation。
沒有長期營養不足證據。

exercises.original: The infant's crying sometimes reflects hunger rather than discomfort.
exercises.zh: 嬰兒哭泣有時反映需要進食，而不是其他不適。
exercises.upgrade: need for food · 需要進食

options.explanation: 個人即時生理需求是核心。
供應不足概念，不是嬰兒當下生理訊號。
長期攝取不足，不能由一次哭泣推論。
病理性食慾問題，原句沒有支持。

words.meaning: 挨餓；飢餓至極；嚴重食物不足
words.note: 比 hunger 強很多，表示長時間、嚴重缺乏食物／能量，可能危及健康或生命。
words.example: The aid programme was designed to prevent starvation during the crisis.
words.exampleZh: 援助計劃旨在防止危機期間出現嚴重挨餓。

exercises.original: Emergency food was delivered to prevent hunger from becoming life-threatening after weeks without reliable supplies.
exercises.zh: 在數星期沒有可靠食物供應後，緊急食物被送到，以防出現危及生命的嚴重挨餓。
exercises.upgrade: starvation · 挨餓；嚴重食物不足

options.explanation: weeks without reliable supplies + life-threatening 明確指出極端、持續的能量不足。
想吃的慾望，不表示缺糧。
只是一種特定食物渴望。

exercises.original: The trapped group survived for days with almost no food and faced severe hunger that threatened their lives.
exercises.zh: 被困的一群人連續多日幾乎沒有食物，面臨危及生命的嚴重挨餓。

options.explanation: 幾乎無食物＋危及生命，是 starvation 的核心語義。
只是取得食物不穩定，力度不足。
不是不想吃，而是沒有食物。
只描述感覺，不表達嚴重程度。

exercises.original: Relief agencies warned that without immediate food deliveries, some isolated communities could die from hunger.
exercises.zh: 救援機構警告，如果不立即送糧，部分孤立社區可能因嚴重挨餓而死亡。

options.explanation: could die 是決定性強度線索。
日常餓感不應與死亡風險等同。

words.meaning: 營養攝取不足；長期熱量不足
words.note: 正式公共衛生／營養術語，通常表示長期攝取能量不足以維持正常健康和活動。
words.example: The survey measured rates of undernourishment among children.
words.exampleZh: 調查量度兒童營養攝取不足的比率。

exercises.original: The study found that many children were experiencing long-term hunger because they regularly consumed too little food energy.
exercises.zh: 研究發現很多兒童長期攝取的食物能量不足，出現營養攝取不足。
exercises.upgrade: undernourishment · 營養攝取不足；長期熱量不足

options.explanation: regularly consumed too little food energy 直接指長期能量攝取不足，是 undernourishment 的核心。
描述取得食物的不穩定，不等於已實際長期攝取不足。
人口層級危機，且需要更廣泛證據。
是另一種營養／體重狀態，與原句相反。

exercises.original: Researchers tracked whether adults were consistently eating fewer calories than they needed for normal activity.
exercises.zh: 研究人員追蹤成年人是否長期攝取少於正常活動所需的熱量。
exercises.upgrade: undernourishment · 長期營養攝取不足

options.explanation: 持續攝取少於能量需要是 formal nutrition sense。
不能量度長期攝取狀態。
不是個體營養測量名詞。
是水分不足，不是食物能量不足。

exercises.original: The nutrition programme was created for communities where people had been eating too little for months.
exercises.zh: 營養計劃為那些數月來攝取食物不足的社區而設。

options.explanation: for months + insufficient intake 明確是長期營養攝取不足。
可能是原因之一，但原句說的是 intake，不是食慾。

words.note: 範圍比 hunger 更廣，包含營養素或能量攝取失衡；可以由吃不夠引起，但也可在熱量足夠時出現。
words.example: The clinic treats children suffering from malnutrition.
words.exampleZh: 診所治療營養不良的兒童。

exercises.original: Doctors found that some children had hunger-related health problems caused by an inadequate diet lacking both calories and nutrients.
exercises.zh: 醫生發現部分兒童因熱量和營養素都不足的飲食而出現營養不良。

options.explanation: inadequate diet + 缺熱量和營養素，正是 malnutrition 的健康狀態語義。
可能是原因，但不等於醫生診斷的營養不良。

exercises.original: The patient was eating enough calories but still had serious nutritional deficiencies.
exercises.zh: 病人攝取的熱量足夠，但仍有嚴重營養缺乏。

options.explanation: 這題刻意強調 enough calories 但有營養素缺乏，說明 malnutrition 比 hunger 更廣。
通常涉及嚴重能量不足，與熱量足夠矛盾。
供應問題，原句沒有提及。

exercises.original: The clinic monitors children's growth because poor diets can lead to hunger-related nutritional problems.
exercises.zh: 診所監察兒童生長，因為不良飲食可能導致營養不良。

options.explanation: growth monitoring + poor diet 是典型營養健康問題語境。
短期餓感不會直接作 growth diagnosis。
供應不足可導致問題，但原句聚焦兒童身體營養狀態。

words.note: 指一個地區或人口群體長時間出現極嚴重食物短缺和廣泛飢餓的危機。
words.example: The drought contributed to famine in several districts.
words.exampleZh: 乾旱令數個地區出現饑荒。

exercises.original: Years of drought and crop failure created hunger across an entire region, with severe food shortages affecting millions.
exercises.zh: 多年乾旱與歉收令整個地區出現饑荒，數百萬人受嚴重食物短缺影響。

options.explanation: entire region + millions + severe shortages + prolonged crop failure 是人口層級重大糧食危機。
個人生理感受，規模完全不合。

exercises.original: Historians describe the period as one in which widespread hunger followed repeated harvest failures.
exercises.zh: 歷史學家把那段時期描述為連年歉收後出現大範圍饑荒。

options.explanation: widespread + repeated harvest failures + historical period 指大範圍糧荒。

exercises.original: Aid agencies warned that the combination of conflict, drought, and collapsed food markets could produce a regional hunger catastrophe.
exercises.zh: 援助機構警告，衝突、乾旱與食品市場崩潰可能造成地區性饑荒。

options.explanation: 多重供應崩潰＋地區性 catastrophe 是 famine 等級的危機語境。

words.note: 正式而直接，表示沒有得到足夠食物，可指短期或長期剝奪。
words.example: Prolonged food deprivation can seriously affect health.
words.exampleZh: 長期缺乏食物會嚴重影響健康。

exercises.original: The experiment examined how prolonged hunger caused by not being given enough food affected concentration.
exercises.zh: 研究檢視長期缺乏食物如何影響專注力。
exercises.upgrade: food deprivation · 食物剝奪；缺乏食物

options.explanation: not being given enough food + prolonged 是直接的 deprivation 語境，正式而精確。
偏好與是否得到食物不同。
想吃的感覺，不是實際缺乏。

exercises.original: Prisoners were exposed to severe hunger because their food intake was deliberately restricted.
exercises.zh: 囚犯因食物攝取被刻意限制而遭受嚴重食物剝奪。

options.explanation: deliberately restricted 強調人為剝奪食物，正是 deprivation 語義。
不是不想吃，而是被限制。

exercises.original: Long periods without adequate food can affect both physical and cognitive performance.
exercises.zh: 長期缺乏足夠食物會影響身體和認知表現。

options.explanation: long periods without adequate food 可直接概括為 food deprivation。

words.note: 最透明、最一般的解釋性表達，不預設特定技術分類。
words.example: Many families were affected by a lack of food after the floods.
words.exampleZh: 洪災後很多家庭受到食物不足影響。

exercises.original: After the floods, many villages experienced hunger because deliveries could not reach them.
exercises.zh: 洪災後，很多村莊因物資無法送達而缺乏食物。
exercises.upgrade: lack of food · 缺乏食物；食物不足

options.explanation: 句子只確定配送中斷導致食物不足，用 plain-English lack of food 最穩妥。
食物不耐受是生理反應，不是供應不足。
可能成為後果，但原句沒有說已形成營養不良。

exercises.original: Families were leaving the area mainly because there was not enough food available locally.
exercises.zh: 家庭離開該區，主要因為當地食物不足。
exercises.upgrade: lack of food · 食物不足

options.explanation: not enough food available locally 是最直接的改寫。
偏好不會直接造成區域人口遷移。

exercises.original: The report links hunger in remote settlements to poor transport and limited local supplies.
exercises.zh: 報告把偏遠聚落的飢餓問題與運輸不便和當地食物供應不足聯繫起來。
exercises.upgrade: lack of food · 缺乏糧食

options.explanation: poor transport + limited supplies 直接造成食物不足。

words.note: 表示可供應的食物數量不足，重點在供應而非個人感覺。
words.example: The conflict caused a serious food shortage.
words.exampleZh: 衝突造成嚴重糧食短缺。

exercises.original: The conflict caused hunger by cutting off deliveries and reducing the amount of food available in shops.
exercises.zh: 衝突切斷運送，令商店可供應的食物減少，造成糧食短缺。
exercises.upgrade: food shortage · 食物短缺；糧食短缺

options.explanation: cutting off deliveries + reduced amount available 描述的是供應量不足。
範圍和語義不對；這裡是市場／地區供應。
可能是長期後果，但不是 supply shortage 本身。

exercises.original: Supermarkets began rationing basic items after supply routes were blocked.
exercises.zh: 供應路線受阻後，超市開始配給基本食品，反映出糧食短缺。

options.explanation: rationing + blocked supply routes 是典型供應不足線索。

exercises.original: Officials released emergency reserves because the harvest was much smaller than expected.
exercises.zh: 由於收成遠低於預期，當局釋放緊急儲備以應付食物短缺。

options.explanation: small harvest + emergency reserves = supply quantity problem.

words.meaning: 食物稀缺；糧食供應不足
words.note: 較正式，表示食物資源稀少、取得困難；常見於政策、經濟和人道分析。
words.example: Food scarcity became worse as transport routes were disrupted.
words.exampleZh: 運輸路線受阻後，食物稀缺問題惡化。

exercises.original: Analysts warned that hunger would worsen because food was becoming increasingly difficult to obtain in remote areas.
exercises.zh: 分析員警告偏遠地區食物愈來愈難取得，食物稀缺將令飢餓問題惡化。
exercises.upgrade: food scarcity · 食物稀缺；糧食供應不足

options.explanation: increasingly difficult to obtain + analytical context 指可得資源稀少，scarcity 很自然。

exercises.original: Drought reduced local production, making basic food increasingly scarce.
exercises.zh: 乾旱降低當地生產，令基本食物愈來愈稀缺。

options.explanation: production down + food increasingly scarce is nearly a direct definition.
scarcity may lead to starvation, but not every scarcity situation has reached that stage.

exercises.original: The report focuses on regions where limited supplies and high transport costs make food hard to access.
exercises.zh: 報告聚焦供應有限、運輸成本高而令食物難以取得的地區。

options.explanation: limited supplies + hard to access 是正式政策分析中的 scarcity 語境。
可能是結果，但原句在分析供應可得性。

words.note: 正式描述性用語，表示食物數量或攝取量不足以滿足需要。
words.example: The study linked persistent food insufficiency with poorer health outcomes.
words.exampleZh: 研究把持續食物不足與較差健康結果聯繫起來。

exercises.original: The study classified households as experiencing hunger when the amount of food available was consistently insufficient to meet basic needs.
exercises.zh: 研究把持續沒有足夠食物滿足基本需要的家庭列為食物不足。
exercises.upgrade: food insufficiency · 食物不足；攝取不足

options.explanation: insufficient to meet basic needs 幾乎直接定義 food insufficiency，且 research register 很合適。

exercises.original: Researchers found that some families repeatedly had too little food to meet normal dietary requirements.
exercises.zh: 研究人員發現部分家庭反覆出現食物量不足以滿足正常飲食需要的情況。
exercises.upgrade: food insufficiency · 食物攝取不足

options.explanation: too little food + dietary requirements + research context = formal insufficiency language.
可能有食物但不想吃，完全不同。

exercises.original: The questionnaire asks whether there was ever not enough food in the household for everyone to eat adequately.
exercises.zh: 問卷詢問家庭是否曾出現食物不足，令所有人無法充分進食。

options.explanation: not enough food ... to eat adequately 是最直接的 insufficiency 線索。

words.note: 表示持續或反覆地沒有足夠食物，時間跨度長。
words.example: The programme aims to reduce chronic hunger in rural communities.
words.exampleZh: 計劃旨在減少農村社區的長期飢餓。

exercises.original: The programme targets hunger that has affected the same rural communities for many years.
exercises.zh: 計劃針對多年來一直影響同一批農村社區的長期飢餓。
exercises.upgrade: chronic hunger · 長期飢餓；長期吃不飽

options.explanation: for many years 是決定性時間線索；chronic 表示長期、反覆或持續。
偏嚴重、即時危機，與多年持續相反。

exercises.original: Children in the area often go to school without enough to eat, and the problem has continued for generations.
exercises.zh: 該區兒童經常吃不飽就上學，而問題已持續多代。

options.explanation: often + continued for generations 明確是長期結構性飢餓。
更適合突發危機中的嚴重短期狀況。
短期且通常自願，與多代吃不飽不符。

exercises.original: Development agencies are trying to address persistent hunger linked to poverty and poor access to food.
exercises.zh: 發展機構正嘗試處理與貧窮及食物取得困難相關的長期飢餓。

options.explanation: persistent + poverty/access drivers 描述長期結構性問題。
通常是危機期間迫切、嚴重的短期狀況。

words.meaning: 急性飢餓；嚴重短期糧食不足
words.note: 表示在危機期間突然或嚴重缺乏食物，通常比 ordinary hunger 更嚴重，並常見於人道援助語境。
words.example: Emergency aid was delivered to families facing acute hunger.
words.exampleZh: 緊急援助送到面臨急性飢餓的家庭。

exercises.original: Emergency teams delivered food to families facing severe hunger after the cyclone destroyed local supplies.
exercises.zh: 風災摧毀當地食物供應後，緊急隊伍向面臨急性飢餓的家庭送糧。
exercises.upgrade: acute hunger · 急性飢餓；嚴重短期糧食不足

options.explanation: cyclone + emergency teams + destroyed supplies 指突發危機造成的迫切嚴重飢餓。
長期問題，不符合災後突發危機線索。
嚴重度與社會規模不足。

exercises.original: Conflict displaced thousands of people and left many without food for several days.
exercises.zh: 衝突令數千人流離失所，很多人數日沒有食物，面臨急性飢餓。

options.explanation: displacement + several days without food + humanitarian crisis 指嚴重而迫切的短期食物不足。
需要更長時間、反覆持續的證據。

exercises.original: Aid agencies prioritised districts where sudden market collapse had left households with almost no access to food.
exercises.zh: 援助機構優先支援市場突然崩潰、令家庭幾乎無法取得食物的地區。
exercises.upgrade: acute hunger · 嚴重短期飢餓

options.explanation: sudden + almost no access + aid prioritisation 是 emergency hunger 語境。
可能後續形成，但原句主要是突發危機。

words.meaning: 飢餓感；餓得胃抽／肚子咕咕叫的感覺
words.note: 指個人身體感到餓時出現的強烈感覺，通常是短期、生理性的。
words.example: By noon, she was beginning to feel hunger pangs.
words.exampleZh: 到了中午，她開始感到明顯飢餓。

exercises.original: By noon, she could feel hunger because she had skipped breakfast.
exercises.zh: 到了中午，她因沒吃早餐而開始感到明顯飢餓感。
exercises.upgrade: hunger pangs · 飢餓感；餓得胃抽的感覺

options.explanation: skipped breakfast + by noon 是短期個人生理餓感，不是社會性食物不足。
是食物取得不穩定，不一定有當下餓感。

exercises.original: His stomach was growling with hunger before dinner.
exercises.zh: 晚餐前，他因飢餓而肚子咕咕叫。

options.explanation: stomach was growling + before dinner 是典型個人生理 hunger sensation。
家庭／攝取不足概念，不是肚子咕咕叫的感覺。

exercises.original: She drank some water to ease the hunger she felt while waiting for lunch.
exercises.zh: 她在等午餐時喝了些水，想減輕餓感。

options.explanation: waiting for lunch + ease the feeling 指短期可感知的餓感。
長期問題，不是午餐前短暫餓感。

falseSynonyms.zh: 一個家庭可能擔心下週買不起食物，已屬 food insecurity，即使今天仍有飯吃。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The children were hungry because they had missed lunch. The household experienced food insecurity because it could not reliably afford enough food.

falseSynonyms.zh: hunger 可以只是幾小時未進食；starvation 通常是長時間、嚴重、危及健康的食物不足。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I felt hungry before dinner. The relief effort was launched to prevent starvation.

falseSynonyms.zh: 有人可能熱量不少但營養結構失衡，仍可 malnourished。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Hunger made him want to eat immediately. The doctor diagnosed malnutrition caused by an inadequate diet.

falseSynonyms.zh: 個人可以 hunger，但整個地區因嚴重食物短缺和廣泛挨餓才會稱 famine。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She felt hunger after skipping breakfast. The region faced famine after repeated crop failures.

falseSynonyms.zh: shortage 可導致 hunger，但它描述的是「食物不夠供應」，不是人的生理感覺。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Hunger affected many displaced families. A food shortage developed after supply routes were cut.

falseSynonyms.zh: 人可能 hungry 但沒有 appetite，也可能有 appetite 但不真正需要額外能量。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He felt hunger after working all day without eating. Illness reduced his appetite.

falseSynonyms.zh: hunger 通常是整體需要食物；craving 可以只想吃巧克力、鹹食等。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She was hungry and needed a meal. She had a craving for chocolate.

falseSynonyms.zh: hunger 是名詞；hungry 是形容詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Hunger can affect concentration. I feel hungry.
